key.name: show-quick-setting
key.summary: Show the tile in Quick Settings
key.description: Whether the Blank Screen tile is added to the Quick Settings grid.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.summary: Show an icon in the top bar
key.description: Whether the indicator icon is visible in the top status bar.

key.name: show-power-menu-item
key.summary: Add an item to the system power menu
key.description: Uses private GNOME Shell internals and may stop working after a Shell update.

key.name: blank-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut for blanking the screen
key.description: GTK accelerator string, for example ['<Super>b']. Empty means disabled.

key.name: lock-instead
key.summary: Lock the screen instead of only blanking it
key.description: Calls the screensaver Lock method, which also shows the lock shield.

key.name: hard-dpms-mode
key.summary: Use hard DPMS instead of the screensaver
key.description: Sets Mutter's PowerSaveMode directly. Input may not wake the display automatically.
